Upgrade plugin ci-notify 0.2.0: "CI failure notifications"
  from      "<plugin-src>"
  hash      sha256:<digest-5>
  tier      declarative
  replaces  0.1.0 (sha256:<digest-1>)
  receives  gh.ci.updated
  publishes nothing
  runs      notify
  settings  signal
  adds
    handler ci-failed: on gh.ci.updated (2 conditions) then invoke notify
! This plugin runs no code of its own: agentflow reads its rules and does only what its permissions allow.
! Writes the plugin starts (notify) wait for your approval before they run.
! plugins.ci-notify.enabled is already true in your settings, so this version runs as soon as the console sees it.
